description: Update a saved job's status, outcome or details. Use status for where the application is now (interviewing, negotiation for an offer, hired). Use outcome for an applied job that ended without progressing: rejected, no_response (no reply after 45+ days), withdrawn, or didnt_apply; status stays as it is. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

outcome.description: What happened after applying, as reported by the user. "clear" removes a recorded outcome.

name: update_job_status
